title: Workspace load fetches every channel's messages before showing the roster
description:
Reported by Ryan during the 1d68fb live run (2026-09-19). On dev, loading the workspace issues one GET /orgs/{tenant}/channels/{id}/messages per channel (about 45 parallel requests observed) and the roster sits on 'Loading conversations…' for around 10 seconds.

Cause: web/components/EnabledWorkspace.tsx (~line 164) awaits Promise.allSettled(loadedChannels.map(listMessages)) before clearing the loading state. selectItem already loads the messages for the selected channel (~line 369), so the eager fetch exists only to fill roster previews.

Fix direction: render the roster as soon as bots and channels arrive; load messages on selection. If the roster needs last-message previews, return the last message with the channels list instead of N extra requests. Cost scales with channel count, so it gets worse as an org grows. Needs a web test that the roster renders without any per-channel message fetch.
